samples.question: The orange ring marks one movable bead. Dark beads move too; striped squares are fixed walls. Read the four arrows from left to right. For each arrow, in every row or column segment split by walls, slide all beads together to the indicated end; beads keep their order and occupy consecutive cells. After all four tilts, which column holds the ringed bead: A, B, C, D, or E?
